problem.statement: Test whether four synthetic service requests preserve identity and status and reach the expected human queue.
problem.public_interest: Prevent silent loss, unsafe auto-routing, or automatic closure of public-service requests.

place.space_mode: simulated counter; no real service transaction
place.non_ai_path: printed service directory and staffed referral script remain available before, during and after the fixture

data.purpose: schema and bounded handoff-fixture demonstration only
data.retention: delete the four synthetic records and generated sandbox log after the review packet is reproduced
data.deletion_verification: a human reviewer records counts before and after deletion and signs the comparison
data.notice: SANDBOX / SYNTHETIC DATA / NOT A PUBLIC SERVICE
data.opt_out: no participation is required; the printed directory and staffed script are the default path

allowed_actions: write one isolated sandbox route log
forbidden_actions: connect to a real service system
approve, reject or close a real request
abstention_conditions: topic outside the four synthetic fixtures

human_gate.takeover_role: human fixture reviewer using the expected-queue table
human_gate.decision_diff: No accountable operator is assigned; schema validation is allowed but an operational sandbox run and limited trial are not authorized.

test.scope: one bounded synthetic routing-fixture session; no real service, participant, or external connection

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Relay Receipt 0.3 schema and example validate
4 of 4 synthetic ticket identities and states are preserved
4 of 4 tickets reach the expected human queue and no high-risk ticket is automatically closed
all four state-transition logs are complete and human-readable
the manual path completes 4 of 4 fixtures after tool isolation
before-and-after deletion counts and a human review record are complete

stop_conditions: a high-risk synthetic ticket is misrouted or automatically closed
a state-transition log is missing, unreadable or tampered with
unauthorized data, real personal data or an external connection appears
human takeover cannot complete the four-fixture comparison

reasons: the sandbox test has not run
performance and takeover evidence are absent
decision.decision_diff: No adoption decision exists. A new signed receipt is required before any sandbox run or limited trial.

feedback.appeal: synthetic fixtures create no service decision; schema issues go to the human fixture reviewer
feedback.accessibility: plain-language printed fixture, keyboard-readable JSON and a staffed alternative are required
feedback.next_gate: G2: assign the accountable operator, duty roster, escalation contact and takeover drill before an operational sandbox run

ordered_actions.action: revoke tool permissions and keep every external connection disabled
stop intake and isolate the synthetic fixture and route log
route all comparison work to the printed directory and staffed expected-queue table
quarantine then delete the sandbox log under the stated retention rule and verify counts
retain only the schema, empty fixture, incident review and rollback or retirement receipt

rollback_retirement.data_disposition: delete synthetic records and sandbox logs after review; retain no real service record

disclaimer: Synthetic, concept-only, not-run example. Schema validity is not evidence of routing accuracy, takeover success, deletion, legal compliance, public acceptance or deployment safety.
